content.short: US consumer banking app with cards and teen accounts.
content.description: Current is a US consumer fintech that delivers mobile-first banking to everyday Americans and, notably, teenagers through parent-managed accounts. Working with partner banks, it offers spending accounts, a debit card, savings pods with boosted rates, fee-free overdraft, faster direct deposit, and money-management tools built for younger and underbanked users. Current has also experimented with crypto access and points-based rewards, but its core is a simple, low-fee everyday banking experience rather than an on-chain wallet. By focusing on accessible accounts, teen banking, and financial-wellness features, Current competes with other US neobanks for consumers who want an alternative to traditional banks and their fees.
content.meta: Current is a US mobile banking app with cards, savings, and teen accounts. Discover Current and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
